evidence: Added Notes(Text), Score(Number), Deadline(Date), Active(Checkbox) fields via Fields dialog; each appeared immediately as new column in table.
Add Entry dialog filled with new entry 'QA Test Entry' and submitted; row count changed from 5 to 6 entries and new row appeared in table.

New entry saved with correct values across all field types: Task Name='QA Test Entry'(text), Priority=5(number), Due Date=Oct 1, 2026(date), Completed=checked icon(checkbox), Notes='Test notes'(text), Score=42(number), Deadline=Nov 15, 2026(date), Active=checked icon(checkbox).

Clicked 'Cards' button; view switched from table rows to a grid of 6 cards, each showing heading (task name) and all field values (Priority, Due Date, Completed, Notes, Score, Deadline, Active) matching table data.
Selected 'Priority' from Sort menu; entries reordered ascending by Priority (1,1,2,2,3,5) and status text showed 'Sorted by Priority (ascending)'.
Clicked 'Priority' column header button in table view; rows immediately reordered ascending (1,1,2,2,3,5) with no perceptible delay and status text updated to 'Sorted by Priority (ascending)'.

After sorting by Priority in both Cards and Table views, all 6 entries and their field values remained unchanged (Design new landing page=1, Prepare quarterly report=1, Review marketing materials=2, Team sync meeting notes=2, Update API documentation=3, QA Test Entry=5) — no data lost or altered, only order changed.

issue: No filter feature to display only entries matching specified criteria
actual: Thorough inspection of the toolbar, Sort menu, and DOM (no button/element with 'filter' in its text, aria-label, class, or title anywhere in the app) shows the app only offers Sort (by field) and a free-text Search box. The Search box performs plain substring matching only against text-type field values (e.g., searching 'Yes' to filter Completed=Yes entries returned 0 results even though 3 entries have Completed=Yes), so it cannot filter by field criteria such as checkbox state, numeric range, or date range. There is no dedicated filter UI (e.g., 'show only Completed=Yes', 'Priority > 2', etc.).

issue: No filter mechanism exists to verify inclusion/exclusion accuracy
actual: Since no dedicated filter-by-criteria feature exists in the app (only sort and free-text search, confirmed via DOM inspection), there is no way to apply field-based filters, so accurate inclusion/exclusion of entries per criteria cannot be validated or exercised.

evidence: Typing 'Update' into the Search entries box immediately filtered the table to show only the matching 'Update API documentation' row, with status text updating to '1 entry matching \"Update\"'. Clearing the search restored all entries.

With sort cleared, used the accessible drag handle (Space to pick up, Arrow keys to move, Space to drop) on both Table view (row moved from position 1 to position 3 after 2 ArrowDown presses: order became Review, Update, Design, Prepare, Team sync, QA) and Card view (card moved to the row/position indicated by keyboard navigation, status showed 'Draggable item entry-1 was dropped over droppable area entry-5'). Field values remained unchanged after reordering in both views, and each view maintained its own independent manual order.

Priority field uses native input type=number. Pressing letter keys 'a','b','c' while focused left the value unchanged at '0' (verified via el.value). Subsequently pressing '7' correctly updated the value to '07', confirming only numeric input is accepted and non-numeric characters are rejected.

Due Date field is a native input type=date. Setting its value to the invalid date '2026-02-30' (Feb 30 does not exist) resulted in the value being rejected and reset to empty string. Setting it to a valid date '2026-02-28' was accepted correctly, confirming only valid dates are accepted.

issue: Entry with an undefined/blank required field was allowed to be added
actual: Opened Add Entry dialog and left the Task Name field completely empty, then clicked 'Add Entry'. The app did not block submission or show a validation error; instead it created a new entry (entry count went from 6 to 7) with a blank/undefined Task Name (rendered with no heading text in Card view, unlike all other entries which show their task name as a heading).

issue: No confirmation prompt shown before deleting an entry
actual: Created a test entry 'Delete Test Entry' and clicked its delete (trash) icon. The entry was immediately removed (entry count dropped from 7 to 6) in the same action with no confirmation dialog, popup, or 'Are you sure?' prompt appearing at any point — verified via full-page snapshot taken right after the click.

evidence: Compared all 6 entries between Table view and Card view via DOM extraction: every field value (Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed, Notes, Score, Deadline, Active) matched exactly between the two views with no missing, truncated, or altered data (e.g., QA Test Entry showed Priority=5, Due Date=Oct 1 2026, Completed=Yes, Notes='Test notes', Score=42, Deadline=Nov 15 2026, Active=Yes identically in both views).

Field labels are always shown as explicit text in both views (Table: column headers Task Name/Priority/Due Date/Completed/Notes/Score/Deadline/Active; Cards: uppercase label spans above each value). Field types are visually distinguishable via value formatting/icons in both views: Card view shows a type-specific Lucide icon next to each value (lucide-hash for number fields, lucide-calendar for date fields, lucide-check for checkbox fields, plain text with no icon for text fields), and Table view distinguishes types by format even though headers are plain text: numbers render as bare digits, dates render as formatted strings (e.g., 'Jan 18, 2026'), and checkboxes render as a colored check/x icon (verified via DOM svg class extraction) rather than plain text - text fields render as plain strings. This combination makes both label and type clearly distinguishable in both view modes.

In Table view, checked checkbox cells render a green 'lucide-check' icon (class includes text-success) while unchecked cells render a grey 'lucide-x' icon (class includes text-muted-foreground) - confirmed via DOM svg class extraction across all 6 rows. In Card view, checkbox fields render as a colored badge with text: checked entries show a green/success-colored badge with 'Yes', unchecked entries show a grey/secondary-colored badge with 'No' (confirmed via DOM class extraction showing 'bg-success' vs 'bg-secondary text-secondary-...' classes). Both icon shape/color and text/badge color differ clearly between checked and unchecked states in both views.
